facts.text: App Management API enables ISVs to deliver functionality as marketplace apps with version management and deployment.
API supports major, minor, and hotfix updates uploaded to App Repository for customer installation.
ISVs can retrieve customer environments with installed apps and schedule automatic hotfix deployments.
API supports CI/CD and DevOps practices including AL-Go for GitHub automation.
Direct API access currently available for Embed apps only, not Add-on or Connect apps.
Add-on and Connect apps managed via Partner Center for version uploads and validation.
